summary: Iteration 36 - Tested Payment Dashboard feature for German 'Kirmes' Billing System. All backend endpoints working (9/10 passed, 1 timeout due to SMTP). Frontend: Payment Dashboard page loads correctly, KPI cards display, event filter works, 'Link senden' buttons visible, Zahlungen button visible in KirmesPage header, Payment summary card visible on Event Detail page. Mobile responsive at 390px.
